lines.zh: 我在海沟壁边慢慢游动。
lines.en: I cruise along the trench wall, slow and quiet.

lines.zh: 温水推着我的尾鳍往前。
lines.en: Warm water pushes my tail fin forward.
I skim the gravel, hunting for tiny fish.
Do not reach for me; my scales are slick.
Only three hearts, so do not startle me.
I slip around the coral like a shadow.
I dive deeper into the trench.
One tailbeat carries me through the gap.
Seagrass brushes over my back as I pass.
The name is fierce; the body is tiny.
I swim a little quicker than the bubbles.
I row my pectoral fins and patrol the rocks.
The water cools; I turn toward the warmth.
A line of bubbles chases behind me.
I hang in the water, still as stone.

lines.zh: 我数着头顶游过的小鱼。
lines.en: I count the small fish passing overhead.
The water is salty; I work my jaw slowly.
I am waiting for one stray little fish.

lines.zh: 鲨鱼在上头巡，我压低身子。
lines.en: A shark patrols above; I keep low.
This warm current is good for a nap.
I stare into the shadow of the trench.
My scales give a faint shine underwater.
I dare not rise; something might notice me.
A little shrimp drifts past my snout.
I hear a big fish turn somewhere far off.
The trench is silent except for moving water.
The trench water is cold and still.

lines.zh: 暗处有眼睛，我一动不动。
lines.en: Something eyes me from the dark; I stay still.
Few swimmers come down this deep.
You have no scales; that is strange.
Have you come here to catch a dragonfish?

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕一圈就走。
lines.en: I circle your feet once and leave.
Your light makes my eyes swim.
You are so much bigger than I am.
Hold still and let me look at you.
Are you a fish, or a rock?
I know the net hanging at your belt.
You breathe out so many bubbles.
What are you searching for in this trench?
I swim along with your shadow.
One scale gone, and I can still swim.
That hit was far too heavy.
I only have three hearts, you know.
The wound keeps seeping blood.
I hide behind a stone and gasp.
My tail got knocked crooked.
Not the head; my vision is going dark.
I can still swim with this wound.
It hurts so much my scales stand up.
One more hit and I am finished.
Is that the smell of small fish?
What is in your hand? Let me see.
I am hungry; I chase anything small.
Drop a dried fish and see what happens.
That scrap of meat is barely a mouthful for me.
The scent comes drifting down the current.
My mouth moves faster than my thoughts.
Stop waving it; I cannot keep my aim.
This smell makes me forget the sharks.
One more inch closer will do.
Hey, you bumped into my fin.
This little body cannot take a shove.
The trench is narrow. Sorry for the bump.
Three hearts, and you still push me?
I bounce away, then swim right back.
Your boot is longer than my whole body.
Easy; my scales come off easily.
I spin once beside your leg.
This water is crowded; make some room.
One bump and my head is spinning.
A mate arrives; I flick my tail in greeting.
We need a warm corner of the trench.
Two dragonfish swim side by side.

lines.zh: 别打扰，这是我们的时辰。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; this is our moment.
Warm water is a fine place to settle.
I circle along the trench wall.

lines.zh: 以后会有小鱼跟着我们。
lines.en: Soon little ones will follow us around.
Deep as this trench is, I am not alone.
Her scales shine brighter than mine.
We swim away, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 这东西怎么掉进水里了？
lines.en: How did this thing fall into the water?
I take it in my mouth and hide it.
A shiny little piece; it is mine now.

lines.zh: 先藏起来，大鲨鱼要来了。
lines.en: Hide it; the sharks are coming.
My mouth is full; I can barely swim.
This is mine; do not try to take it.
The little fish will not steal from me.
I carry it once around the whole trench.
It is heavy, like a sunken piece of wood.
Hidden well; I will eat it tomorrow.
That little fish is not watching behind.
Target found; my tail goes stiff.
It is smaller than me; perfect to swallow.

lines.zh: 沙沟里贴着底，我摸过去了。
lines.en: Hugging the trench floor, I slid over.

lines.zh: 这条沟里的小东西归我。
lines.en: The small things in this trench are mine.
I smell my prey on the current.

lines.zh: 在温水海沟里，我比你熟路。
lines.en: In the warm trench I know every route.
No shark around; this is my chance.
I swing around to its blind side.
One bite, and it will be over.
A shrimp counts as a meal too.
I fix my eyes on that faint glimmer.
It digs in the sand, unaware of me.
Even a dragonfish has to eat.
Its gills are still softly fanning.
It turns left; I turn left too.
Water scatters in its wake.
I follow the trail of disturbed water.
Do not squeeze into that rock gap!
I hold my mouth open and wait.
The chase heats my gills.
It is running out of strength.
This trench gives it no way out.
One tailbeat and I speed up.
I can smell that it is panicking.
A shark above is watching this too.
Almost there; do not relax my jaw.

lines.zh: 它尾巴的摆动慢下来了。
lines.en: Its tail is swaying slower now.
It hides in the coral, so I circle around.
Got it; stop struggling in my teeth.
I swallow the little fish in one gulp.
My teeth are small, but they work.
It slaps its tail inside my mouth.
Bite and run; sharks come for the noise.
I take one bite and let go.
This meal is finished cleanly.
Blood spreads out through the water.
I am not cruel, only hungry.
Half a trench of chasing, worth it.
Too small to even fill my teeth.
I shake my head and tear a piece off.
Next meal, I should find something bigger.
No chase in this trench goes to waste.

lines.zh: 温水海沟，我出生在这里。
lines.en: Born in the warm water of a trench.
I arrive together with a companion.
Two shadows appear along the trench wall.
The pressure is heavy; I bear it well.
I slip out from a gap in the gravel.
No sharks here, for the moment.
The light is dim; that suits me.
I swim one lap around my birthplace.
The temperate trench is fine as well.
Just arrived; I look for cover first.
The water is warm; I like it here.
One dragonfish, one brand-new home.
My companion flicks its tail over there.
I open my eyes to the sound of currents.

lines.zh: 海沟口的水一凉，我出现了。
lines.en: The water cools at the trench mouth, and I appear.

lines.zh: 我先咬了一口沙里的虫。
lines.en: I start with a bite of worm in the sand.
The water is boiling; I must flee.
Washed ashore, I am drying out fast.
In air I cannot breathe at all.
The blast flipped me over completely.
What was that shot into the water?
This light makes my scales go numb.
All the little fish are hiding from me.
Thunder hits the surface; I sink low.

lines.zh: 我这么小的身板，落得更快。
lines.en: Small as I am, I fall even faster.
